original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚高原州警方逮捕32名嫌疑人并缴获10支步枪
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高原州警察指挥部在近期行动中逮捕32名嫌疑人，涉及绑架、人口贩运等罪行，并缴获10支步枪和54发实弹。州警察局长阿约德吉·法尼扬在乔斯总部向记者通报了上述行动成果。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Plateau State, Command Headquarters in Jos

key_facts.fact: 高原州警方逮捕32名嫌疑人，涉及绑架、人口贩运等罪行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Plateau State Police Command has arrested 32 suspects for various offences, including kidnapping and human trafficking

key_facts.fact: 警方缴获10支步枪和54发实弹
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: recovered 10 rifles and 54 rounds of live ammunition in operations across the state

key_facts.fact: 州警察局长法尼扬在乔斯总部向记者通报行动成果
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: disclosed this on Friday while briefing journalists at the Command Headquarters in Jos

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
